sloka: हृष्टः कथय विस्रब्धो यावत् आरोप्यते धनुः ।सृष्टः च हि मया बाणो निरस्तः च रिपुः तव ॥४-८-४४॥
transliteration: hṛṣṭaḥ kathaya visrabdho yāvat āropyate dhanuḥ ।sṛṣṭaḥ ca hi mayā bāṇo nirastaḥ ca ripuḥ tava ॥4-8-44॥

translations.english: 'Tell me freely and cheerfully before I string the bow. Your enemy will be destroyed as soon as I release my arrow.'
